mode: Built-in image generation for photographic artwork; exact SVG composition with deletion-only comparisons.

sources.name: remove-courtyard-cinema-photo
sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic banner for a believable neighborhood summer outdoor-cinema poster. Primary request: an intimate ordinary brick courtyard prepared for an outdoor film screening at blue hour, neat rows of assorted simple folding chairs, a small projection screen softly glowing without any recognizable movie scene or writing, understated warm string lights and a few plants. Modest local community atmosphere, inviting and practical, realistic evening exposure and textured weathered brick. No people, logos, posters, prices or readable text. Edge-to-edge editorial photograph only, not a poster or layout. Landscape 3:2 framing, composed so the courtyard, chairs and screen remain visible in a shallow wide photo crop.

comparisonPolicy: Only marked groups are deleted. Every retained element keeps identical text, styling, position and image bytes/crops. Poster removes one repeated admission badge; coffee removes a care seal and border; report removes a community-update block. There is no reflow or replacement copy.
